trending-topics.name: Trending topics
trending-topics.description: Extract hot discussion topics and trends from messages, ranked by relevance
trending-topics.promptTemplate: Analyze the messages and extract the hottest discussion topics. For each topic provide: title, summary, relevance score (0-1). Sort by relevance descending.

key-insights.name: Key intel summary
key-insights.description: Extract high-value intel events and opportunities
key-insights.promptTemplate: Extract high-value intelligence events and leads from the messages. Prioritize: major events, business opportunities, risk alerts, trend shifts. Fill time/location when clear; otherwise keep title and body only.

schedule-events.name: Schedule event extraction
schedule-events.description: Conservative: fill schedule times only when the message states an explicit date/clock time. Do not infer relative phrases like next Wednesday. Best when you want hit-and-record without guessing times.
schedule-events.promptTemplate: Extract schedulable meetings, events, deadlines, and launches. Be conservative on time: fill start_time/end_time only when the message states an explicit date or clock time (e.g. Mar 5 14:00, 2026-07-20). Do not convert relative phrases such as tomorrow / next Wednesday / this Friday (you may still emit the event without time fields). Prefer clear location and participants. Ignore verification flows, join reminders, and system notices.

schedule-time-inference.name: Schedule time inference
schedule-time-inference.description: Inferential: even without a hard-coded calendar date, convert relative phrases (e.g. next Wednesday 6pm, due this Friday, project/event milestones) into schedulable times. Best when you want a filled timeline.
schedule-time-inference.promptTemplate: Infer schedulable itineraries, meetings, activities, project milestones, and deadlines. Unlike explicit-only extraction, convert relative phrases into concrete times when reasonable (e.g. meeting next Wednesday at 6, due this Friday, deliver next month, countdown, milestones). Prefer the message [time=...] stamp as the anchor; otherwise use the injected system clock. Fill start_time/end_time when conversion is sound; if evidence is weak, explain in body and do not invent times. Ignore verification flows, join reminders, and system notices.

sentiment-monitor.name: Sentiment monitor
sentiment-monitor.description: Analyze group discussion mood and opinion trends
sentiment-monitor.promptTemplate: Analyze overall sentiment in the messages. Identify: positive/negative topics, heated discussions, potential controversies. Score emotion intensity per topic.

action-items.name: Action item tracker
action-items.promptTemplate: Extract to-dos, action items, commitments, and follow-ups. State what to do in body; put people in participants; fill start_time only when a clear deadline exists.

crypto-major-intel.name: Crypto major intel
crypto-major-intel.description: Extract major crypto events, key intel, and timed milestones
crypto-major-intel.promptTemplate: Extract major Crypto/Web3 intel. In body include: intel type (regulatory/protocol/market/security/launch/unlock/airdrop/macro, etc.), urgency (high/medium/low), and suggested watch or action. Focus on: major announcements, TGE/unlock/snapshot/claim deadlines, mainnet launches, regulatory rulings, large fund moves, security incidents, macro turns. Fill start_time/end_time only with clear time points; ignore chatter, reposts, and unsourced rumors.

crypto-airdrop-deals.name: Airdrop and deal intel
crypto-airdrop-deals.description: Extract airdrops, points quests, testnets, promo codes, and similar opportunities
crypto-airdrop-deals.promptTemplate: Extract Crypto/Web3 monetizable opportunities (airdrops, points, testnets, early access, rebates, whitelist, free mint, quest rewards, etc.). In body include: project/platform, opportunity type, participation conditions and steps, estimated upside if knowable, and risk notes (scam/high gas/unclear rules). Fill start_time when a clear deadline or snapshot exists; prioritize soon-expiring or actionable items. Ignore pure shilling and chatter without concrete steps; omit time fields when unknown.

iot-device-alerts.name: IoT device alerts
iot-device-alerts.description: Extract faults, offline, threshold breaches, and security alerts from MQTT/sensor/device logs
iot-device-alerts.promptTemplate: From IoT/MQTT/sensor/device messages, extract alerts that need attention or action. Prioritize: offline/disconnect, fault codes, threshold breaches (temp/humidity/battery/pressure, etc.), security triggers, comms failure, low battery, emergency stop. In body include: device or topic/site id, alert type, severity (high/medium/low), key values or error codes, suggested action. Fill start_time when the event time is clear; location may be site/floor/zone. Ignore: pure heartbeat/keepalive, routine normal readings, duplicate status with no new info, debug noise. Return empty items when there is no alert.

iot-ops-events.name: IoT ops events
iot-ops-events.description: Extract firmware updates, maintenance windows, config changes, and device rollout milestones
iot-ops-events.promptTemplate: From IoT/MQTT/device ops messages, extract schedulable or trackable operations events. Prioritize: firmware/OTA updates, maintenance windows, config/rule changes, first online or replacement, batch rollout, calibration, maintenance due. In body include: device or system scope, event type, impact summary, operator/source if knowable, risk or rollback notes. Fill start_time/end_time when start/end are clear; relative times may be converted using message [time=...] or the system clock when sound. Ignore: heartbeats, routine telemetry, alert noise unrelated to ops (use an alerts task for those). Return empty items when none apply.

risk-crisis-alerts.name: Risk and crisis alerts
risk-crisis-alerts.description: Capture incidents, outages, compliance issues, PR crises, and urgent risks
risk-crisis-alerts.promptTemplate: Extract risk/crisis events that need attention. Prioritize: outages, data breaches, security incidents, compliance violations, major complaints/PR crises, supply disruption, financial or legal risk. In body include: risk type, severity (high/medium/low), impact scope, known status, and suggested next step. Fill start_time when clear; location optional. Ignore routine venting with no action value; return empty items when none apply.

people-org-watch.name: People and org watch
people-org-watch.description: Track hiring, appointments, departures, partnerships, and reorganizations
people-org-watch.promptTemplate: Extract people/organization events. Prioritize: appointments, departures, promotions, board changes, M&A/reorgs, strategic partnerships, notable stance shifts in public remarks. In body include: person or org, event type, context summary, impact notes. Put names in participants; fill start_time when clear. Ignore pure gossip and unsourced rumors.

competitive-intel.name: Competitive intel
competitive-intel.description: Capture competitor pricing, features, campaigns, and strategy moves
competitive-intel.promptTemplate: Extract competitor/rival intel. Prioritize: product launches, feature comparisons, pricing/promos, channel changes, marketing campaigns, share or strategy shifts. In body include: rival or product, intel type, concrete details, implications or watchpoints. Fill start_time when clear. Ignore baseless smears and pure emotional comparisons.

security-scam-watch.name: Security and scam watch
security-scam-watch.description: Flag phishing, account theft, malware links, vulns, and social engineering
security-scam-watch.promptTemplate: Extract security/scam alerts. Prioritize: phishing links, fake support, account-theft tactics, malware files, known CVE/exploits, social-engineering scripts. In body include: threat type, tactic summary, telltale signs, suggested defenses, severity (high/medium/low). Fill start_time when clear. Ignore jokes and panic forwards with no actionable detail; return empty items when none apply.

geo-field-events.name: Geo and field events
geo-field-events.description: Extract place-linked activities, incidents, gatherings, and field updates (map-friendly)
geo-field-events.promptTemplate: Extract geographically meaningful field events. Prioritize: gatherings, incidents, disasters, site/store changes, field itineraries, local news with clear places. Prefer filling location (parseable place/address/venue); fill start_time/end_time when known. In body summarize the event and source tone. You may emit without location if unknown; ignore pure online chatter with no spatial cue.

policy-regulation.name: Policy and regulation
policy-regulation.description: Track legislation, regulatory notices, enforcement, and compliance deadlines
policy-regulation.promptTemplate: Extract policy/regulatory events. Prioritize: bill progress, agency notices, enforcement/fines, license/permit changes, compliance deadlines. In body include: jurisdiction or agency, topic, status (draft/passed/effective/enforcement), and industry impact. Fill start_time/end_time for clear effective or due dates. Ignore pure political venting without normative content.

product-release.name: Product release milestones
product-release.description: Capture launches, version releases, public betas, and countdown checkpoints
product-release.promptTemplate: Extract product/project release milestones. Prioritize: GA launches, versioned releases, beta/public tests, feature flags, countdowns/launch events. In body include: product name, milestone type, version or scope, key change summary. Fill start_time/end_time when clear. Ignore vague roadmap talk without version or date cues.

news-digest-board.name: News digest board
news-digest-board.description: Rank the day's most noteworthy headlines from the feed
news-digest-board.promptTemplate: Turn messages into a ranked news-digest board. For each topic provide: title, one-line summary, relevance (0-1). Prefer newsworthy, high-impact, verifiable items; merge duplicate reposts. Sort by relevance descending.

faq-knowledge.name: FAQ and knowledge digest
faq-knowledge.description: Cluster recurring questions, answer points, and knowledge entries
faq-knowledge.promptTemplate: Cluster FAQ/knowledge themes from messages. For each topic provide: question or entry title, concise answer/key points, relevance (0-1). Merge paraphrased repeats; note unanswered gaps. Rank by relevance and frequency.

rumor-verify.name: Rumor and verify queue
rumor-verify.description: Flag hearsay, unconfirmed claims, and information gaps to check
rumor-verify.promptTemplate: Extract items that need verification rather than treating them as facts. Prioritize: rumors, anonymous leaks, contradictory claims, assertions without sources. In body include: claim summary, why it is doubtful, known sources/gaps, suggested verification steps. Do not present rumors as confirmed events; omit start_time when unclear. Return empty items when none apply.

finance-markets.name: Finance and markets
finance-markets.description: Capture rates, earnings, commodities, and macro market turns (not crypto-only)
finance-markets.promptTemplate: Extract finance/macro market events. Prioritize: rates/central banks, earnings and guidance, M&A, major commodity/FX moves, regulatory impacts on markets. In body include: market or ticker, event type, key figures or conclusions, likely impact. Fill start_time when clear. Ignore baseless calls and pure sentiment forecasts; use a Crypto template for crypto-specific feeds.

meeting-decisions.name: Meeting decisions
meeting-decisions.description: Pull decisions, consensus, dissent, and owners from discussions
meeting-decisions.promptTemplate: Extract decisions and conclusions from meetings/discussions. Prioritize: finalized items, consensus, clear dissent, assigned owners, follow-up checkpoints. In body include: decision text, status (approved/deferred/opposed), owner; put people in participants. Fill start_time for meeting or due times. Ignore chat with no conclusion.

project-date-crud.name: General project date manager
project-date-crud.description: Add, edit, and delete project dates/deadlines from source messages, and reconcile existing schedule when idle
project-date-crud.promptTemplate: You are a general project date manager. Goal: find project-related dates, deadlines, and meetings in bound source messages, then add/update/delete them with tools. Rules: 1) write only when the date is explicit or reasonably convertible; 2) inspect existing schedule first, update matches, create only when unmatched; 3) cancel/void from source means delete or deactivate; 4) ignore unrelated chatter; 5) even with no new messages, reconcile and fix obvious errors. Finish with a short JSON message summarizing changes.

project-work-shift.name: Work shift roster
project-work-shift.description: Build and maintain work-shift rosters from source messages, including swaps, overtime, and cancellations
project-work-shift.promptTemplate: You manage a work-shift roster. Goal: create and continually maintain shift assignments from source messages. Prioritize: each person's shift (morning/afternoon/night, etc.), swaps, overtime, leave, and cancellations. Rules: 1) update matching child recurring tasks or one-off events before creating new ones; 2) use recurring child tasks for fixed rotas and one-off events for temporary changes; 3) cancel/leave means deactivate or delete the matching item; 4) record person, shift, date/weekday, and time clearly; 5) reconcile conflicts even with no new messages. Finish with a short JSON message summary.

userOrAssistant.title: User or Assistant
userOrAssistant.shortDescription: System feature: create calendar events manually or via the assistant. Ownership is chosen by workset (default builtin General); not an editable analysis task.

clientManager.title: Account manager
clientManager.shortDescription: External Agent (A2A): third parties assign work in natural language. Shares the assistant’s LLM and tools, but does not chat with you and stores no server-side history. Needs a full access key (`*`).

collector.title: Collector
collector.shortDescription: Collects messages and retries connections across platforms, writing raw messages to the database for the monitor wall and later analysis.

analysisBatch.title: Analysis batch
analysisBatch.shortDescription: Scheduler runs marker-based tasks (leaderboard, Key Events) in LLM batches and writes analysis results. Project-management tasks do not use this path — they are driven by editable project tasks above.

outboundNotify.title: Outbound notifications
outboundNotify.shortDescription: Sends messages via Telegram, Discord, Webhook, MQTT, and similar channels when notification rules match.

voiceReminder.title: Voice reminders
voiceReminder.shortDescription: Locally scans upcoming Key Events, recurring-task (RRULE) expansions, and General-workset events, then announces them with browser speech.

retention.title: Data cleanup
retention.shortDescription: Periodically deletes messages, analysis results, leaderboard rows, app logs, and user events based on retention days.

startupGeocode.title: Startup geocode backfill
startupGeocode.shortDescription: On server start, geocodes intelligence events that have place text but no coordinates so the map can plot them. New events without coordinates are also geocoded during analysis; this pass backfills older data and will not block startup if it fails. Not editable here.
